scope: Public, dated observations and source interpretations. No ad scripts executed; no actual impressions, account holders, contracts or payments established. Revenue-model defaults are hypothetical. Corrections: 4/5 manager declarations; complete seller rows exclude malformed entries; root has no SUBDOMAIN delegation.

sources.title: Google · AdSense tag parameters
sources.note: Defines publisher and ad-unit parameters. Used only to interpret the code; this does not establish that the sites use the AdSense for Platforms product.

sources.title: Google · page RPM and ad RPM
sources.note: Defines revenue normalization by page views versus ad impressions. Calculator values are hypothetical; no network RPM was recovered.

sources.title: Google · AdSense revenue share
sources.note: General AdSense for Content terms, not verified payouts or terms for every installed advertising product.

sources.title: IAB Tech Lab · ads.txt 1.1 specification
sources.note: Sections 3.3, 3.5.1 and 5.5 explain seller relationships, manager declarations and subdomain precedence. Declarations do not verify contracts or transactions.

sources.title: MGID · publisher advertising formats
sources.note: Describes native, display and video widgets and content recirculation. Product capability is not evidence that a format was delivered on the inspected page.

sources.title: Google · Ad Manager path structure
sources.note: Explains the network code and slash-separated unit hierarchy. Used to interpret the path, not to claim these GPT pages use tagless requests.

sources.title: Google · display a rewarded ad
sources.note: Documents consent, readiness, supported conditions and fill. A configuration declaration alone does not establish display or a reward.

sources.title: Google · managing multilingual websites
sources.note: Separate language URLs and annotations help readers and search engines reach the intended edition.

sources.title: AdSense · eligibility requirements
sources.note: The eligibility page does not publish a numerical traffic threshold; it sets original-content, compliance, site-access and applicant requirements.

sources.title: Journey · current minimum requirements
sources.note: Updated 14 August 2026. Requires 1,000 premium sessions over 30 days and connected GA4; includes content, audience and platform conditions.

sources.title: Mediavine · Journey changes
sources.note: Published 7 August 2026. Describes premium-market examples and confirms Grow and the old 30-day Grow wait are optional/removed.

sources.title: Raptive · current eligibility
sources.note: Updated 5 June 2026. Traffic volume, geography, domain age, editorial quality and site conditions all matter.

sources.title: Raptive · AI-assisted content policy
sources.note: Updated 30 June 2026. Describes meaningful human involvement, review, fact-checking and editing, and extensive-use disclosure guidance.

sources.title: Raptive · content and traffic policies
sources.note: Updated 10 July 2026. Excludes traffic bought with the aim of earning more from advertising.

sources.title: AdSense · purchasing traffic
sources.note: Paid acquisition must satisfy Google requirements. This does not establish profitability or override another ad partner’s restrictions.

sites.name: usceleb247.com
sites.observation: The current homepage is an empty news shell but still contains advertising references. Its About page names htvnetworkllc.
sites.meaning: Connects directly to the Long Bien subdomains through the AdSense identifier and to all four About pages through explicit branding.
sites.limit: No current article inventory, rendered ad, verified payee or underlying contract was established from this home capture.

sites.name: us115.longbientruck.com
sites.summary: AdSense · Ad Manager · GA4 · video players
sites.observation: The sampled article combines nine AdSense elements, a rewarded Ad Manager definition, GliaCloud player paths and shared measurement configuration.
sites.meaning: Shares the publisher, rewarded unit, nine slot IDs and base analytics with us23; also shares the AdSense ID with USCeleb247 and the GAM network code with Noi That.
sites.limit: The nine elements are configured placements. No ad impression, reward, revenue or article author was verified. The root ads.txt does not delegate to this subdomain.

sites.name: us23.longbientruck.com
sites.summary: Same publisher & GAM · separate extra GA4
sites.observation: The sampled article has the same nine AdSense slots and rewarded unit as us115, with a different additional analytics ID.
sites.meaning: Provides a close match in ad and measurement configuration to us115. Its seller file is byte-identical to USCeleb247’s.
sites.limit: The shared parent domain already makes an operational relationship unsurprising. Ad delivery, account holder and payments remain unknown.

sites.name: noithatnhaxinhbacgiang.com
sites.summary: Shared GAM network · HTV About · own GA4
sites.observation: The empty news homepage defines a Google Ad Manager display slot and references a reward-labelled delivery script. Its About page names htvnetworkllc.
identifiers: Only in ads.txt; absent from sampled home HTML
sites.meaning: Links to the Long Bien properties via the GAM network code and to the other About pages through explicit branding. Its theme stylesheet matches USCeleb247’s.
sites.limit: A seller-file entry is weaker than an embedded publisher parameter. Tanngo is an inventory label, not verified personal identity.

sites.name: longbientruck.com (root)
sites.date: 10 Sep 2026 · public HTML and seller file
sites.observation: The root homepage is a Vietnamese truck storefront. Its seller file contains the same Google publisher as a DIRECT declaration.
sites.meaning: Establishes the root/subdomain distinction and the seller declaration governing the domain under the cited IAB rule.
sites.limit: This does not establish the truck business’s knowledge of or control over all subdomains. Seller rows do not prove ads delivered or account ownership.

sites.name: autulu.com
sites.observation: Independent fact-checks document fabricated celebrity narratives and social distribution involving this domain.
sites.meaning: Supports historical publication and distribution practices independently of the CBC video.
sites.limit: The failure is not a shutdown finding. No current ad setup or HTV ownership was independently verified from it.

sites.name: btuatu.com
sites.observation: The Basketball Lovers archive contains a Btuatu link. Later fact-checking documents Kelce Fan Club Family distributing Btuatu material.
sites.meaning: Shows dated distribution relationships and independently examined fabricated stories.
sites.limit: It does not identify the complete current network or prove common ownership of every distributing account.
